look_here_first: Smooth green annual with slender terminal spikes, rounded or notched leaf tips, only three tepals, and a small indehiscent rugose fruit.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Amaranthaceae/Amaranthus: alternate petiolate leaves and dense clusters of tiny unisexual flowers. Habit, plant sex, hairiness, nodal spines, cluster position, bract/tepal form, and fruit dehiscence are high-value characters.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaf apex often rounded or emarginate

lookalikes.differences: Smoother and more slender than redroot pigweed; no nodal spines; thinner seedhead than most erect pigweeds.
